title: Delphi Artifact Prompt Log Entry
description: One line of local/artifact-log/<mission>/artifact-prompts.jsonl (spec 070 §3): the redacted operator prompt behind one artifact create or edit. Written by the daemon only; hash-chained.

ts.description: UTC RFC 3339 time of the write.

prompt.description: The operator's prompt, redacted. Never context or a model reply.

artifact_hash.description: blake3 of the artifact after the write.

prev.description: Hash of the previous entry, or `genesis`.
